notes.title: 2.0 battle base new version update
notes.notes:
1: Dynamic weather environment system, from day, evening, fierce fighting to late night, every 30 minutes, the environment changes, night fighting will also bring exciting light and shadow chasing effect!



2: Gold dispute mechanism, everyone can fight for inexhaustible gold! Gold mine will be produced synchronously with the refresh of survival circle



3: Exclusive base construction play, everyone can spend a little gold and a certain power value to build their own base building on the land of the limit Island, all kinds of building functions are different, free to use, build your base home!



4: Add cool rookie mount, anti gravity power board, the initial action is not slow!



Balance and partial functional adjustment:



Tax calculation of Fortress



All PVE damage rebalance calculations



Increased the distance and damage of throwing weapons



Increased the survival reward in the survival circle

notes.title: Version 1.1 super body fortress War Update
notes.notes:
1.1 battle of super fortress

[b] [H1] do you want to fly the flag with your head in the super body fortress of extreme island? Let your ID and avatar fly on the extreme island! [/h1][/b]

The latest version of the super fortress war system is a 24-hour free siege. In the original big escape RPG element, you can choose to land and fight for the sovereignty of the super fortress

When you destroy the core of the super fortress, you can control the core and gain the control, tax and sovereignty of the super fortress

When the new version opens, the fortress is in the neutral stage. Players only need to destroy the city gate and plant virus into the super body core to become the first fortress Lord

The Lord can buy fortress guns and place turrets at will in the fortress theater to help the LORD defend the fortress

Lords can collect taxes from all players in extreme Island (tax forms are various, please refer to the instructions in the game for details)

In particular, the avatar Battle Flag mechanism is added. The player's steam avatar will be suspended after occupying the fortress, and it can also be displayed on the map page. It's time to become the red man of extreme survival

----------------------------The new year's gold test was cancelled-----------------------

Greatly increase the distribution of ammunition, supplies and weapons dropped by air

Fixed some bugs in previous versions
